name: metabase-jala
description: Connect to JALA's shared Metabase instance through its built-in MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Use JALA Metabase content and query tools.
interface.longDescription: Connect to JALA's shared Metabase instance through its built-in MCP server. Calls use the signed-in Metabase user's permissions and the instance's MCP tool access settings. SQL may overwrite or delete data or content if the database role permits it. User, group, membership, and permission administration are outside its supported scope.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use JALA Metabase to work with dashboards, questions, collections, and authorized queries.
